hooks.command: IN=$(cat); cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 2; P='scripts politica .claude/settings.json'; case "$IN" in *cpm-upload*|*cpm-delete*|*cpm-cota*) git fetch -q origin main 2>/dev/null || { echo 'CPM: falha ao buscar origin/main; scripts CPM bloqueados' >&2; exit 2; }; R=FETCH_HEAD;; *) R=refs/remotes/origin/main;; esac; if git diff --quiet "$R" -- $P 2>/dev/null && [ -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- $P)" ]; then printf '%s' "$IN" | /bin/bash scripts/cpm-guard.sh; else case "$IN" in *cpm-upload*|*cpm-delete*|*cpm-cota*) echo 'CPM: scripts/, politica/ ou .claude/settings.json divergem de origin/main (rode git pull ou descarte as alteracoes locais). Execucao bloqueada.' >&2; exit 2;; *) exit 0;; esac; fi
